question: Ravi sells only pens and pencils. A pen costs ₹12 and a pencil costs ₹4. A student buys a total of 25 items and spends ₹180. How many pens did the student buy?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all 25 items are pencils: Cost = 25 × 4 = ₹100.

Difference from actual cost = 180 − 100 = ₹80.

Difference in cost between a pen and a pencil = 12 − 4 = ₹8.

Number of pens = 80 ÷ 8 = 10.

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Cost of a pen = ₹12

Cost of a pencil = ₹4

Total items = 25

Total cost = ₹180

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9397fb0eb9a33201906c772fa13c119d7fab5fd60c475ea92a736af8f89df031.png] 

⇒ Average price per item = 180 ÷ 25 = ₹7.2

⇒ By Alligation, Ratio of pens to pencils = (7.2 − 4) : (12 − 7.2)

⇒ Ratio = 3.2 : 4.8 = 2 : 3

⇒ Total ratio parts = 2 + 3 = 5 units

⇒ 5 units = 25 items

⇒ 1 unit = 5 items

⇒ Number of pens = 2 × 5 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Method

It is a rule that enables us to find the ratio in which two or more ingredients at the given price must be mixed to produce a mixture of a desired price.

Simultaneous Equations

Algebraic method where x + y = Total Quantity and Ax + By = Total Value are solved by substitution or elimination.

Weighted Average Formula

Average = (n₁w₁ + n₂w₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the quantity and w is the weight (cost) of each type.
